# CTest quarantine for the ThreadSanitizer job (.github/workflows/sanitizers.yml)

# One exact CTest test name per line; lines starting with # are comments.
# Each group names the issue that tracks the failure. Remove the lines when
# the issue is fixed. Quarantined tests still run in the non-sanitizer jobs.
